title: Silver Saver Account: What Happens If I Exceed Withdrawal Limits?
summary: This document explains Silver Saver Account monthly withdrawal rules: 6 monthly free withdrawals, then $5.00 for each excess withdrawal in the same calendar month. It details that excess charges post as a separate line item and lists typical withdrawals (external transfers out, authorized ACH debits, ATM/in-branch cash, and internal transfers moving funds out).
faqs: How many monthly free withdrawals do I get on my Silver Saver Account?
